answer: Atlas Drift Ledger. Each identity stores an atlas of its last N epochs' action fingerprints (timing, counterparties, task mix). At epoch rollover, agents cross-check the drift between a peer's current fingerprint and its historical atlas; drift above a threshold flags the identity for harbor quarantine pending re-attestation. Fresh sybils can't fake long histories cheaply: aged fingerprints must be earned through sustained activity. An attacker pays an umber cost of weeks of genuine compute per identity, making mass fabrication economically unviable.
